_doc: Rows of fig_maze_conditions panel (a), top to bottom (PW-1 item 1, Head-ruled 2026-09-25). One entry = one row. schema 'w19' = a 3-seed BARS artefact, rows.nway.per_seed[arm]; the comparator is the matched baseline with the highest mean over the row's seeds (every kind, both step limits). schema 'six' = the six-seed words-plus-observation TEST read of maze_six.py (per-seed run JSONs, asserted float-equal to REL-NEWSEEDS.json); 'comparator' = 'best_matched' (the matched baseline with the highest six-seed mean) or 'transformer_rel' (the Transformer given the relational columns, the step limit with the higher six-seed mean); 'check_source' = a 3-seed BARS artefact whose seeds 0-2 must equal the six-seed read. No claim label, no ceiling, no hard/easy class anywhere. Panels (b), (c) are the six-seed read of the two 'six' rows.
